# CenterLinked

> One live organization referral link for behavioral-health and addiction-treatment BD teams. Not a patient directory.

CenterLinked is a B2B referral platform. Treatment organizations maintain a branded profile — facilities, levels of care, in-network insurance, and who to contact — and share one URL with professional referral partners.

It is invite-oriented and work-email gated. It does not store PHI, provide medical advice, or list programs for consumers searching for treatment.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Login](/login): Sign in with a work email.
- [Signup](/signup): Create an account (work email required).
- [Request access](/request-access): Ask to join if you do not yet have an invite.
- [Privacy](/privacy) and [Terms](/terms).

## Pricing

Organization membership is $99/month. Optional Done For You setup is $499 once, then the same $99/month membership.
